phenotypicFeatures.description: slowly progressing upper and lower limb girdle weakness
few necrotic and numerous atrophic fibers
vacuoles appeared filled with polysaccharide material that showed glycogen structure
vacuoles were present almost exclusively in type 1 fibers, which were also diffusely atrophic
numerous, discrete, deposits of basophilic material... representing nemaline bodies (NBs)
